name: Depth / 3D
summary: Glass plates floating in perspective: your dashboard on the floor, Pulse as the audit layer hovering above it.
look: Airy blue-grey gradient with a fading floor grid, translucent white glass plates with bright edges and deep soft shadows, dashed teal Z-rails and outlined ghost copies of the wordmark.

components.name: Glass plate
components.role: white 74 % + bright inner edge + hairline + deep soft shadow, r22 — the only surface type

components.name: Exploded stack
components.role: one 3D rig, plates 120–150 px apart in Z, joined by dashed rails

components.name: Z-rails
components.role: 3 px dashed teal lines along the depth axis; make the space legible

components.name: Ghost echoes
components.role: outlined teal copies of the wordmark that stream forward and lock into one plane

components.name: Audit layer
components.role: glass panel hovering ~300 px above the floor table; a coral drop-line pins the anomaly to its cell

components.name: Depth collapse
components.role: end state: all angles 0°, Z 0, two hairline echoes as a memory of the depth

motion.name: Plate fly-in
motion.how: translateZ −400 → 0 with 20° → 0° tilt, expo.out 0.6 s, one plate per beat (0.5 s at 120 BPM)

motion.name: Camera orbit
motion.how: rig rotateY −34° → −28° + dolly 8 %, sine.inOut over 2 bars (4 s) — keeps the stack alive between hits

motion.name: Drop-line pin
motion.how: coral line draws 0 → 100 % in 0.25 s (power2.in) exactly on a bar downbeat, followed by a 2-ring ripple 0.4 s

story: Hook: a stack of dashboard plates explodes along Z around the question. Reveal: four ghost planes slide into one flat Acme Pulse plate on the drop. Proof: the team metrics table lies on the floor while the Pulse glass layer floats above, ticking metrics until a coral line pins Checkout conversion −18% (since 09:42, after deploy #2231) and Roll back is offered. CTA: depth collapses to a flat lockup with a coral Start free button.
adapt: Put your customer’s existing tool on the floor plate and your product as the hovering glass layer; any audit, copilot or observability product maps 1:1. Replace the plate contents with your own real screens exported as flat PNG/HTML.

references.note: 3D CSS planes and cubes in a product launch page
how CSS perspective builds a shared 3D space

fit.risk: Tilted text becomes unreadable on phones; 3D rigs are fiddly to keep seek-safe.
